Wellness trackers I'd use instead of Oura.
Oura tracks your night. WHOOP tracks your strain. Lumysi tracks your wrist.
None of them can see the 8 hours you sit at a desk.

Pixl Nub is a tiny desk robot — radar for focus, interruptions, presence, breathing and heart rate. No camera. No wearable. No subscription. $200 on Kickstarter this October.
